figure.climbingBandAria: One climbing band split in two: speaking is the wide half at the start and the narrow half later; deep listening does the opposite. Neither ever stops.
figure.cyclePillCaption: One go, as it looks on the player screen: you hear the phrase, then the wide middle stretch is your turn to say it out loud, then two different voices say it properly.
figure.wornPathAria: Reaching for a phrase wears a path into the ground; recognising one on a page leaves the ground unmarked.
figure.nothingToRevise: nothing to revise, nothing to memorise
figure.threeGapsAria: Three gaps: one where the answer arrives, one where it half arrives, one where it comes out wrong. All three carry the same tick.
figure.spacingAria: A line through a session: new things arrive along the top, and each one comes back below at widening intervals.
figure.comesBackFurtherApart: and it comes back, further apart each time
figure.listeningStretchAria: The speaking rhythm of beats and gaps gives way to one long unbroken line of listening, with no gaps in it, and then the speaking resumes.
figure.noGaps: no gaps, nothing asked of you
figure.simplyPlays: it simply plays, then the speaking returns
figure.calloutOneGo: One go: you hear it, then your turn, then twice properly.
